summary: GFL Environmental Inc. filed a Form 6-K with its unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the three months ended March 31, 2026. The filing is a routine quarterly report by a foreign private issuer, containing financial statements, MD&A, and CEO/CFO certifications. It discloses a net loss from continuing operations of $219.2 million but does not announce any M&A, restructuring, or other special-situation event. The figures are standard reporting; no deal terms, activist activity, or strategic changes are present. This is an ordinary earnings release with no special-situation trigger.
